page: Microsoft Azure NV12ads_V710_v5 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NVadsV710v5 family. It is powered by an x86_64 AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 12 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 5.33 GB of RAM per core.

For hardware acceleration, this server is provisioned with a fractional GPU allocation of 0.5 of an AMD V710 GPU, providing 11 GB of dedicated VRAM. Storage capabilities include a local 825 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring moderate GPU acceleration and fast local storage, such as virtual desktops, entry-level 3D rendering, and database hosting. The fractional GPU allocation offers a cost-efficient alternative to full-GPU instances for tasks that do not require a dedicated physical GPU.
